crumbs.label: IPC Receives Special Recognition Award for Outstanding Contribution to Pharmaceutical Research at CPHI India Pharma Awards 2024

title: IPC Receives Special Recognition Award for Outstanding Contribution to Pharmaceutical Research at CPHI India Pharma Awards 2024
bodyHtml:
Greater Noida, November 26, 2024: The Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC) is proud to announce that it has been conferred the “Special Recognition” award under “Outstanding Contribution to Pharmaceutical Research by Academic Institutes” at the prestigious CPHI India Pharma Awards 2024 held at India Expo Centre, Greater Noida. The award acknowledges IPC’s remarkable contributions such as the publication of the Indian Pharmacopoeia (IP) 2022, launch of the IP Online portal, harmonization of IP standards through IPC’s membership in the Pharmacopoeial Discussion Group, and acceptance of the IP standards in various foreign countries.

The award reflects IPC’s collective commitment to advancing pharmaceutical research and quality standards. This recognition underscores IPC’s efforts in aligning with the government’s vision of leveraging technology for healthcare advancements.

The IPC extends its gratitude to all stakeholders and team members who contributed to this achievement.
